Everything on the phone can be used and changed: settings, other apps, installing and removing apps.\n\nIt stays unlocked, even after a restart, until someone taps \"Lock the phone again\" on the home screen. Do not hand it back to its user unlocked.

This turns the phone back into a normal Android phone. The home screen lock and all its protections go, the deployment\'s apps can be uninstalled, and Simple Phone stops managing the phone.\n\nIt cannot be locked again. The only way back is to erase the phone completely and set it up again from the trainer\'s phone.
To fix something and lock the phone again afterwards, use \"Unlock this phone\" instead.
